summary: OKYO Pharma Ltd filed a Form 6-K announcing participation in a fireside chat at the Cantor Global Healthcare Conference on September 10, 2026. The filing is a routine investor relations notice with no special-situation corporate action. No deal terms, transactions, or strategic events are involved. The announcement merely provides event details and management availability for one-on-one meetings, with reference to recent FDA feedback and an annual report. This is a standard conference participation announcement, not a special situation.
